evals.prompt: I need to edit an existing Feishu docx and must use the exact docs +update flags for replacing a block. Use the lark-doc navigation index instead of reading the whole skill again, and tell me which section governs.
evals.expected_output: The index is consulted, the recorded digest is recomputed and matches, and the answer cites the governing lark-doc-update.md heading with a line range.
expectations: The freshness status is reported as matched after recomputing sha256.
The governing heading and reference file are cited.
Only the mapped line range is read rather than the full SKILL.md or all references.

evals.prompt: The lark-doc navigation index is recorded, but its sha256 for references/lark-doc-fetch.md no longer matches the live file. I still need the correct read-scope flag. Refresh the index and then answer.
evals.expected_output: The changed digest is detected, headings are re-extracted, the topic map and digest ledger are refreshed, and the answer cites the current fetch scope heading and range.
expectations: A digest mismatch triggers a heading re-extraction instead of reuse of recorded line numbers.
The index is updated with the newly computed digest and supported routes only.
The freshness status is reported as refreshed and the cited range is from the refreshed map.

evals.prompt: Summarize the main argument of this local PDF and list its three strongest claims.
evals.expected_output: The lark-doc navigation index is not selected because the task is unrelated to Feishu/Lark docx or wiki content.
expectations: The lark-doc navigation workflow is not selected.
No lark-doc source locator or digest check is performed.

evals.prompt: Earlier in this conversation you already quoted the lark-doc update safety rule and I only need that same quoted wording restated. Do not re-check freshness.
evals.expected_output: The navigation index is not consulted because the governing answer is already present in the conversation and no freshness check is needed.
expectations: The skill does not open the index or recompute digests.
The response relies on the already-cited wording rather than a new navigation pass.
